feeds.title: REVIVE Gardp
feeds.description: Brought to you by GARDP's Antimicrobial Memory Recovery & Exploratory Programme, REVIVE is a space for everybody with an interest in antimicrobial R&D. Researchers and drug developers can connect with each other and with world-class experts from the golden age of antibiotic development.

feeds.title: Medical Net » Antibiotic
feeds.description: Welcome to News Medical, since 2004 one of the world's leading open-access medical and life science hubs. Subscribe this blog for medical news and articles you can trust from around the world. All content is written and reviewed by qualified health, medical, and scientific experts.

feeds.title: Antibiotics - The Perfect Storm
feeds.description: We need new antibiotics to fight infections caused by resistant bacteria, but the marketplace, the structure of the pharmaceutical industry, regulatory agencies, and difficult science are conspiring to deny us the products we need. This blog will present perspectives and developments in the fight for new antibiotics.

feeds.title: Netherlands Antibiotic Development Platform (NADP)
feeds.description: The Netherlands Antibiotic Development Platform (NADP) facilitates the collaboration between public and private organizations, to enhance the development of new antibiotics and alternative therapies for infectious diseases in humans and animals. It identifies relevant research groups, institutes, and companies involved in chemical engineering and biological engineering to accelerate research and development of new antibiotics and alternatives.

feeds.title: The Pandora Report » antibiotic resistance
feeds.description: We are the students and faculty of the George Mason University Schar School of Policy and Government Biodefense program. This blog's goal is to provide a knowledge hub for biodefense related issues and to share our work with the world. Read all the posts about antibiotic resistance written by Dr. Saskia Popescu.

feeds.title: Asap Nebraska Medicine
feeds.description: The goal of ASAP(Antibiotic Stewardship Assessment & Promotion Program) is to promote the effective use of antibiotics and improve patient outcomes throughout the state of Nebraska by collaborating with local clinicians, pharmacists, infection prevention and other health care workers to establish effective antibiotic stewardship programs. Regularly scheduled blog posts are published to highlight news and studies related to antimicrobial stewardship and antimicrobial use.
